name: nexalink-crm
description: NexaLink CRM — AI Relationship CRM (React 18 + Node.js + MySQL)

scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && mkdir -p backend/public && cp -r frontend/dist/* backend/public/
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
